sources.title: Fine Tuning LLMs: Complete Guide for 2026 - solguruz.com
sources.snippet: Explore More AI Topics Key Takeaway Fine-tuning an LLM adapts a pre-trained model to a specific task or domain without training from scratch. The most popular methods include SFT (Supervised Fine-Tuning), LoRA, QLoRA, and RLHF. Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning (PEFT) techniques like LoRA make fine-tuning possible on consumer-grade GPUs.
